Help-center excerpts:

[card-fraud-lock] Why is my card locked by Tallowbrook? (effective 2025-01-01)
the lock straight away.
- If there's no alert, message us in the app. Support will pass your case to the Fraud team. Support can't remove a fraud lock, and neither can the freeze switch.

The Fraud team replies within 2 business days, often much sooner.

## Meanwhile

Deposits and incoming transfers still arrive while your card is locked. You can also still use BrookPay and transfers, unless the Fraud team has restricted those too.

We will never ask you to confirm a fraud alert by giving us your full card number, PIN or a

[transfers-link-external] Linking an external bank account (effective 2025-01-01)
arrive in 1 to 2 business days. Enter the two amounts in the app within 14 days to finish linking. After that, the link expires and you need to start again.

## Rules

- The external account must be in your name. We can't link accounts that belong to someone else, including a spouse.
- You can link up to 5 external accounts.
- New linked accounts may have lower transfer amounts for the first few days while we confirm them.

Your Tallowbrook routing and account numbers are shown in the app under Account details, if the other bank asks

[check-deposit-availability] When check deposits are available (effective 2025-01-01)
The app shows the release date on the deposit.

## Returned checks

If the check bounces after the money was made available, we take the amount back from your balance. There's no returned item fee.

Deposits made on a weekend or bank holiday count as received on the next business day.

## Check the status

Tap the deposit in your activity feed to see whether it's pending, available or returned.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[account-under-review] Account under review or restricted (effective 2025-01-01)
Sometimes we need to review an account, for example to confirm identity details, check unusual activity, or meet legal requirements.

## What you can do during a review

You can still receive deposits. Depending on the review, you may not be able to send money, withdraw cash, use your card or order a new card.

## What you'll see

A banner in the app tells you the account is under review or restricted, and what we need from you, if anything.

## How long it takes

It depends on the reason. If we need documents, sending them quickly is the best

[transfers-pending] Why is my transfer pending? (effective 2025-01-01)
A transfer can show as pending for a few reasons. Here's how to tell what's going on.

## Waiting for the cutoff

ACH transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, or on a weekend or holiday, stay pending until they're sent on the next business day.

## On its way

Once sent, ACH transfers take 1 to 3 business days to arrive. The app shows the expected arrival date on the transfer.

## Under review

Some transfers are reviewed before they're sent, for example a large first transfer to a newly linked account. The app shows

[fee-changes-2026] What changed in the March 2026 fee update (effective 2026-03-01)
2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can

[security-fraud-alerts] How fraud alerts work (effective 2025-01-01)
If you don't answer

If you don't answer within 24 hours, the card stays locked until you contact us.

## Is this alert real?

Real alerts appear inside the Tallowbrook app. A text alert only ever asks you to reply YES or NO, and never contains a link. We never ask for your card number, PIN, password or a one-time code to confirm an alert. If someone calls you about a fraud alert, hang up and open the app instead.

## Too many alerts?

Alerts are more common when you shop somewhere new or abroad. They get less frequent

[cushion-plus] Cushion on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
purchase that would take you past $50.00 below zero is declined.

## Limits

Cushion covers debit card purchases only. It never covers ATM withdrawals, transfers or wires.

## Repaying

Your next deposit repays it. If you stay negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. If the balance is still negative after 60 days, the account is restricted until it's repaid.

## Cost

Cushion has no fees and no interest ($0.00). It isn't a loan and isn't reported to credit bureaus.

Still stuck? Chat with us

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
